summary: Design VS-AI PLAYABLE: bot spawned, wired, granted ability, WALL-P-poked, casts at target

synthesis.vsai_a1_arm_summary: VSAI-A1 puppet-bot is a one-variable extension of E4T-A9's proven WALL P defeat, substituting `bot`/`botAsc` for `hero`/`playerAsc` as the ability-instance owner while holding the target-side state bit-identical to E4 F3's [M] positive result (spawned minion, MinionTeamID=100, Loki.log `Property Health new value` as the primary damage receipt). Placement is a new function `BsVsaiPuppetCast()` gated behind `KBFVSAI=1`, invoked from `BsLadderStep`'s KBSPS block AFTER `BsTrackDKill` completes STATIONS 1-3 (which construct a real `LokiAbilitySystemComponent` on the bot via `AddComponentByClass + K2_InitStats(LokiAttributeSet, LokiAttributeSetHealth) + InitAbilityActorInfo`, and cache the ASC at `bot+0xF00`). The KBFTRACKD_DELTABITS knob is forced to `0x00000000u` (0.0f) so Track D's AdjustHealth is a no-op and the bot survives to cast. The nine-station body reuses `BfBuildSpec` + `BfGiveAbilityNative` (the same [M] class-agnostic engine grant used for the player at `[ASC.vtable+0x778]=0x552DC80`), resolves the bot's ability instance via `botAsc.Items[i].Rep.Data[0]` at `InputID==KBFVSAI_INPUTID`, then executes the E4T-A9 compound poke (`[inst+0xF58]=2 Warmup`, `[inst+0xF48]=*(inst+0xF20) WarmupPhase subobj`) → `ProcessEvent(Invoke, zero-parm)` via vtable slot 78 (disp `0x270`) → `Sleep(INVOKE_DELAY_MS)` → loop `KBFVSAI_REPS` × `ProcessEvent(HitVerb, [NULL, &target, zeroed 240B])` at `INTERVAL_MS`, and restores both pokes on exit. Every offset (`+0xF58`, `+0xF48`, `+0xF20`, Items TArray at `+0x538`/`+0x540`, spec stride `0xF8`, spec fields `+0xC`/`+0x24`/`+0x90`/`+0x98`) is stock UPROPERTY/`FGameplayAbilitySpec` class-level layout confirmed [M] on `ULokiGameplaySpell`/`ULokiAbilitySystemComponent`, so the mechanism transfers to a bot-owned instance by construction. Target defaults to the E4-spawned minion (`g_bfE4Target`, `BP_Minion_KaijuAxeLeader_Stagger_Tutorial_C`, seeded 100 HP by E4's `BfE4SpawnSeedTarget`); TARGET=1 selects `g_bfHero` for the follow-up flight. Ship as three build variants — `-readonly` (REPS=0, first flight, proves 6/7 open questions with zero HP mutation), `-mindash` (Ability3+DashHit, matches E4T-A9-proven config, REPS=4), then `vsai-a1` (LMB+MeleeHit, minion target, REPS=8) — with `KBFVSAI=0` default so all parent gates (`botai 5e47c13cf7f0a158`, `play 9bc10a4552c596e1`, `-seedmax b47d1bfd04e44921`, `e4-t-a9`) reproduce byte-identical.
synthesis.target_recommendation: TARGET=0 (minion, `g_bfE4Target` = `BP_Minion_KaijuAxeLeader_Stagger_Tutorial_C`) for the first flight, non-negotiable. Rationale (Lane 3): E4 F3 already provided a [M] TARGET-side positive control for spawned-minion damage receipt via the game's own damage path — Loki.log emitted `Property Health new value is: 0.00` and `GC_Ronin_Execute_Highlight_C` fired as INDEPENDENT WITNESS that the (attacker=-1, target=100) pairing is accepted as hostile at the damage-application layer. VSAI-A1 changes exactly ONE variable — attacker identity swaps player→bot — and holds the target-side state bit-identical, so a null cannot ambiguate between "attacker-swap broke the mechanism" and "player-death collateral broke the flight". Player-as-target carries UNBOUNDED collateral risk from death cam / respawn dialog / GameState phase transitions / elimination broadcast / PlayerState death-flag propagation, none of which any prior shim flight has exercised under live ability-instance mutation. FK-32 base rate on this project is meaningful (S156-A lost 4/5 launches to FK-31/32 hazards even without exercising unfamiliar death code) and player-death-under-shim would compound it. Also the Loki.log `Property Health new value` line is a free, HUD-independent, per-write receipt (S156-B postshots1/postshots2 + E4 F3 all corroborate) that generalises to N≥2 shots — a player target would compete with the game's own HUD-driven HP display for observability. Additionally, first flight should be the `-readonly` variant (KBFVSAI_REPS=0) BEFORE `-mindash` (REPS=4) BEFORE full `vsai-a1` (LMB+MeleeHit, REPS=8): readonly proves 6 of 7 open [S] questions in ONE hazard-minimal flight (bot ASC resolves at bot+0xF00, K_GRANT lands, ability instance builds at Rep.Data[0], compound poke succeeds with readback verify, Invoke ProcessEvent doesn't fault, bot's grant vtable behaves identically to player's) with zero HP mutation and zero downstream game-state changes. Player-target flight (`vsai-a1-player`, KBFVSAI_TARGET=1) is a strict follow-up only after `vsai-a1` (minion+LMB) succeeds and `-mindash` proves the mechanism on both a proven ability config (Ability3/DashHit, matches E4T-A9 [M]) and the untested-but-desired LMB config in isolation. Ability class for first flight is Ability3 (MiniDash Charges, non-selector, matches E4T-A9's [M] proven config) — LMB (Ability1) requires GS_Ronin_LightAttack1_Selector_C sub-spell resolution which was proven on the player in E4T-LMB but is untested on a bot, so ship it in the `vsai-a1` variant only after `-mindash` succeeds and isolates the Selector variable.

knobs.name: KBFVSAI
knobs.purpose: Master gate. 0 = dead-strip entire VSAI-A1 body so parent builds (botai, play, -seedmax, e4-t-a9) reproduce byte-identical. 1 = compile in BsVsaiPuppetCast + invocation site.

knobs.name: KBFVSAI_ABIL
knobs.purpose: UPROPERTY name on the hero class to read the ability CLASS from (bot inherits hero class). Ability3=MiniDash Charges (non-selector, matches E4T-A9 proven config). Change to "Ability1" for LMB after -mindash succeeds.

knobs.name: KBFVSAI_INPUTID
knobs.purpose: InputID passed to BfBuildSpec + used as the filter for Items[] iteration to find the ability instance. Ability3=5, Ability1(LMB)=3. Must match KBFVSAI_ABIL's canonical InputID.

knobs.name: KBFVSAI_TARGET
knobs.purpose: 0 = g_bfE4Target (spawned minion, TeamID=100, seeded 100 HP by BfE4SpawnSeedTarget under KBFE4). 1 = g_bfHero (player). TARGET=0 required for first flight per Lane 3.

knobs.name: KBFVSAI_HITVERB
knobs.purpose: UFunction name resolved on the ability instance for the damage verb loop. Pair with Ability3=DashHit / Ability1=MeleeHit. Verb takes [NULL(8B), &target(8B), zeroed 240B pad] parms.

knobs.name: KBFVSAI_REPS
knobs.purpose: Number of hit-verb ProcessEvent calls after Invoke. 0 = READONLY variant (proves setup chain works without any HP mutation, first flight only). 4 = -mindash. 8 = full vsai-a1 (matches E4T-A9's REPS to kill 100 HP).

knobs.name: KBFVSAI_INTERVAL_MS
knobs.purpose: Sleep between hit-verb ProcessEvent calls. Matches E4T-A9's proven interval. Longer intervals reduce game-thread hold; shorter risks the target's ASC clamp firing before all writes commit.

knobs.name: KBFVSAI_INVOKE_DELAY_MS
knobs.purpose: Sleep between ProcessEvent(Invoke) and the first hit-verb call. Matches E4T-A9. Lets the WarmupPhase→InvokePhase transition settle before firing damage verbs.

knobs.name: KBFVSAI_POKEVALUE
knobs.purpose: Value written to inst+0xF58 (CurrentStateSpecPhaseType). 2 = ELokiSpellPhaseType::Warmup. E4T-A9 [M] proved 2 opens the phase gate for Dash/MeleeHit. Do not change without a UHT re-read of the enum.

build_variants.name: vsai-a1-readonly
build_variants.purpose: FIRST FLIGHT. Hazard-minimal validation. Proves bot ASC resolves at bot+0xF00, K_GRANT lands on bot's ASC, ability instance builds at Rep.Data[0], compound poke succeeds with readback verify, Invoke ProcessEvent doesn't fault — 6 of 7 open [S] questions in ONE flight with zero HP mutation. Predicts RESULT=READONLY_INVOKE_OK.

build_variants.name: vsai-a1-mindash
build_variants.purpose: SECOND FLIGHT. Matches E4T-A9-PROVEN config (Ability3=MiniDash Charges + DashHit + 4 reps) with attacker swapped bot→minion. Predicts RESULT=HITS_ALL_APPLIED + minion HP 100→0 in Loki.log.

build_variants.name: vsai-a1
build_variants.purpose: THIRD FLIGHT. LMB + minion target. Adds one variable vs -mindash: Selector sub-spell resolution (GS_Ronin_LightAttack1_Selector_C). If NO_INSTANCE returns, fall back to -mindash to isolate whether Selector or bot-ownership is the cause.

build_variants.name: vsai-a1-player
build_variants.purpose: FOLLOW-UP. Only after vsai-a1 (minion) succeeds. TARGET=1 selects g_bfHero as the damage target. Carries unbounded collateral risk from player-death code paths (death cam, respawn, GameState transitions) never exercised under live shim mutation — budget 3-4 launches, watch FK-32.

pre_registered_null_meanings: RESULT=NO_BOT (g_trackdBot invalid) → Track D STATION 1 never populated the global. Either KBFTRACKD=0 (build error should have caught this) or Track D flight-aborted before STATION 1 completed. Verify Track D marker: [TRACKD] TRACKD_BUILD line present with statsOk=2/2. If missing, refactor the bot-spawn precondition, not VSAI.

RESULT=NO_BOT_ASC (bot+0xF00=null) → Track D STATION 2/3 didn't cache the ASC. Either AddComponentByClass failed silently or the bot+0xF00 offset is wrong for this build. Read Track D's [TRACKD] TRACKD_BUILD asc=0x<X> — if X is non-null, VSAI's PropOffsetSuper(botCls,'AbilitySystemComponentStorage') diverges from Track D's hardcoded 0xF00 write. Fix: use the same lookup Track D uses.

RESULT=NETSIM_GATE_CLOSED (botAsc+0x800=<non-zero>) → Track D's line 19203 zero-write didn't take. Suspect a subsequent write. Log the byte in Track D's STATION 3.5 marker AND in VSAI STATION 1 to catch the transition.

RESULT=NO_TARGET (g_bfE4Target invalid) → E4 didn't spawn or didn't seed the global. Verify E4's BfE4SpawnSeedTarget marker fired. KBFE4=1 build error should have caught this at compile time; if not, the #error guard has a defect.

RESULT=NO_ABIL_CLASS (prop 'Ability3' not found or null on bot class) → Bot class isn't a Ronin subclass, or the UPROPERTY name changed. Check bot class name via ClassOf(bot) + GetFNameStr. E4T-A9 uses the same lookup on the player — if it works there and fails here, bot's class chain differs from hero's.

RESULT=GRANT_FAILED (BfBuildSpec faulted OR flt=true handle<=0) → K_GRANT didn't land on bot ASC. If flt=true, BfBuildSpec has an untested code path on a bot-owned SourceObject. If handle=-1, spec.Ability validation failed (spec.Ability != CDO — check the marker printed just before). If handle=0 with Items 0->0, AbilityScopeLockCount gate closed on a fresh ASC → grant queued to AbilityPendingAdds; retry after Sleep or use post-hook commit path.

RESULT=NO_INSTANCE (Items.Num>0 but no match at InputID) → GRANT succeeded but ability instance not built at Rep.Data[0], OR InputID mismatch. Read every Items[i]+0x24 to see what InputIDs actually landed. Selector complication: GS_Ronin_LightAttack1_Selector_C's sub-spell may not populate Rep.Data on bot; fall back to -mindash to isolate.

RESULT=NO_WARMUP_SUBOBJ (inst+0xF20=null) → Ability instance's WarmupPhase sub-object not constructed. This would mean the ability instance layout on a bot differs from the player's — refuting Lane 2's Q1 (offsets are class-level). Would require a UHT FPropertyParams re-read on the bot instance's class chain via fk13uht.py.

RESULT=POKE_FAILED (SEH or not writable) → +0xF58 or +0xF48 not writable. Ability instance may be in a protected memory region on bot ASC (unlikely, same class as player). Read the region flags before poke.

RESULT=FN_RESOLVE_FAILED (Invoke=null or HITVERB=null) → FindBPFunc didn't find Invoke/DashHit on the bot's ability instance. Either the BP class chain lookup fails for bot-owned instances, or the UFunctions live on a superclass not in the walk. Same class as player's instance — should be identical.

RESULT=INVOKE_FAULTED → ProcessEvent(Invoke, zero-parm) SEH-caught. Likely CurrentActorInfo.AvatarActor mismatch — Track D bound AvatarActor=bot (S190 Track D verified), but Invoke body may cast AvatarActor to a player-specific type. Would require reading Invoke's disassembly at ULokiGameplaySpell::Invoke impl RVA to identify the specific cast.

RESULT=HIT_FAULTED (hitsApplied=0, hitsFaulted=all) → ProcessEvent(DashHit/MeleeHit) SEH-caught. Damage verb assumes something about attacker context (owner PlayerController, HUD, damage-mitigation chain). Same class as player — should transfer, but bot's controller is AAIController not APlayerController. May need to spoof a fake PlayerController on bot before calling.

RESULT=HITS_PARTIAL (some applied, some faulted) → intermittent fault, likely target-side state changing between shots (e.g., first shot kills target and second shot faults on dead-actor null-check). Read Loki.log Property Health values between shots to distinguish.

RESULT=READONLY_INVOKE_OK but Loki.log has no bot-ability-related lines → confirms the shim path works but the game's own event system didn't broadcast anything. Fine for readonly — the primary success metric is the STATION markers, not gameplay side effects.

STATION9 restore=FAULTED → compound poke couldn't be reversed. Ability instance memory freed between poke and restore (unlikely on 300ms timescale). Leaves bot's ability in Warmup phase — subsequent auto-fire attempts by bot's AI tree would find an ability stuck in Warmup. Read post-flight bot ASC state before next injection.

No Loki.log Property Health line despite RESULT=HITS_ALL_APPLIED → damage verbs fired but didn't apply damage. Suspect: target's ASC hostility gate refuses same-team damage (if bot spawns with TeamID=100 matching minion). Read bot's TeamID via IDLokiCharacter's TeamIndex UPROPERTY before flight; if 100, spawn target minion of different class or poke bot's TeamID to -1.
open_risks: [S] Bot ability instance offsets (+0xF58, +0xF48, +0xF20) may differ from player's — Lane 2 Q3 argues they're class-level UPROPERTY offsets (identical for any ULokiGameplaySpell instance regardless of owner) but no bot-owned instance has been byte-measured. NO_WARMUP_SUBOBJ REFUSE branch guards. Mitigation: -readonly flight's STATION 6 marker reveals if the poke lands.

[S] Engine grant virtual at [botASC.vtable+0x778]=0x552DC80 assumes bot's ASC has identical vtable to player's. Both are LokiAbilitySystemComponent instances (same class), but Track D constructs via AddComponentByClass (fresh instance) vs KWIREGAS's borrowed carrier — untested that vtable layout is identical. GRANT_FAILED branch guards.

[S] Ability instance's Rep.Data[0] population timing on a bot ASC. GiveAbility → CreateNewInstanceOfAbility populates it in stock UE, but may differ on Loki's ASC. If Rep.Num=0 after GRANT, need Sleep+retry or ScopeLock check. NO_INSTANCE branch guards; -readonly flight isolates this from downstream mutations.

[S] Cross-ASC damage application — MeleeHit/DashHit apply damage via ApplyGameplayEffect. Whether bot's ability instance can write to target's (minion or player) Health via its own GAS pipeline is untested for the bot-attacker direction. S191 E4T proved player→minion works; VSAI-A1 tests bot→minion. HIT_FAULTED or 'no Loki.log Property Health line' branches capture the failure mode.

[S] CurrentActorInfo.AvatarActor = bot pawn (not player pawn). Downstream Dash/DashHit body may take different branches for a non-player avatar. GC_Ronin_Execute_Highlight_C fired on E4 F3 with attacker=player; whether it fires with attacker=bot is unknown. Primary receipt (Loki.log Property Health) is HUD-independent and should still fire if damage reaches target's ASC.

[S] Selector complication for LMB — GS_Ronin_LightAttack1_Selector_C's sub-spell resolution on a bot ASC. E4T-LMB variant needed additional handling on the player. Mitigation: -mindash first (Ability3=non-selector, matches E4T-A9 proven), then vsai-a1 (LMB) as isolation flight.

[S] Bot team identity is UNMEASURED. If SpawnAIFromClass defaults bot to TeamID=100 (matching hostile tutorial minions), damage-application gate may refuse same-team damage. Cheap preflight: read bot's TeamID via LokiCharacter UPROPERTY. If 100, poke to -1 OR spawn target minion of different class.

STATION 3.5 CDO cross-contamination — Track D's DxAppend on shared borrowed CDO ASC's SpawnedAttributes runs process-wide, but only if !setInSpawned. Real-ASC path (AddComponentByClass) sets it via K2_InitStats, so 3.5 is skipped. VSAI must not re-enter 3.5. Gated by Track D's marker check before VSAI runs.

FK-32 base rate: budget 3-4 launches per clean flight. S190 Track D alone lost 3/8 launches to FK-31 hazards. Adding K_GRANT + compound poke + ProcessEvent chain on top of S190-D's ASC build increases live mutation footprint. Preserve markers between staging attempts.

BsVsaiPuppetCast runs inside OnPI hook on game thread. Sleep(INVOKE_DELAY_MS + REPS × INTERVAL_MS) = 300 + 4×250 = 1300ms default for -mindash blocks game thread. Longer than BsTrackDKill's ~50ms but shorter than PdCdoFlags' ~2000-2300ms sweeps that already ship. Should not trigger FK-32 baseline.

g_bfE4Target and g_bfHero global names inferred from CLAUDE.md's E4 documentation. If actual names in tutorial_launch.cpp differ, code delta needs one-line correction. Verify against E4T-A9's own code paths before building.

vsai-a1-player TARGET=1 carries unbounded collateral risk from player-death code paths (death cam, respawn dialog, GameState phase transitions, elimination broadcast, PlayerState death-flag propagation) never exercised under live shim mutation of an ability instance. Only fly after -mindash and vsai-a1 (minion) succeed.

Bot's autonomous AI tree could concurrently populate Blackboard.TargetEnemy if the damage cue on the minion triggers an AI perception event that names the bot as attacker. Would mix puppet-drive with autonomous-drive under a shim. Read bot's BB_HeroBots.TargetEnemy at end-of-flight to check.

Regression gates must remain BYTE-IDENTICAL: botai 5e47c13cf7f0a158, play 9bc10a4552c596e1, botfight-damage-self-cal-bindavatar-seedmax b47d1bfd04e44921, e4-t-a9 <existing>. Guaranteed by #if KBFVSAI ... #endif with NO #else branch and KBFVSAI=0 default. Verify with text_digest.py --dupes clean after every build.

findings.lane_name: Lane 1 — Bot ASC + Ability Grant Mechanics

key_findings.finding: The bot's ASC pointer is exposed to the shim in TWO equivalent places, both readable after Track D's STATION 2 runs. (a) Marker line: `[TRACKD] TRACKD_BUILD asc=0x%llX cachedF00=... statsOk=.../2 initAAI=... owner=... netsim %u->%u` — the `asc=0x...` value IS the botAsc. (b) Live re-derivation: `bot + PropOffsetSuper(ClassOf(bot),"AbilitySystemComponentStorage")` which resolves to `bot+0xF00` on this build — Track D cached the ASC there at line 19180 (`if(cached) *(uintptr_t*)(bot+f00)=botAsc;`). Any downstream arm can call `BfGetAsc(bot)` (defined at line 19084-19086, reads `bot+0xF00` by name) to recover it symmetrically with how the player's ASC is looked up.
key_findings.evidence: tutorial_launch.cpp lines 19176-19180 (`botAsc=AddCompByClass(bot,ascCls,"TRACKD-ASC"); ... if(cached) *(uintptr_t*)(bot+f00)=botAsc;`), lines 19205-19207 (marker `TRACKD_BUILD asc=...`), lines 19084-19086 (`BfGetAsc(actor)` reads `AbilitySystemComponentStorage`).

key_findings.finding: K_GRANT works identically on the bot ASC — vtable disp 0x778 is the SAME entry (base+0x552DC80) on both player and bot because Track D creates a `LokiAbilitySystemComponent` instance (via `AddComponentByClass(LokiAbilitySystemComponent)`), which is the exact class the player's ASC also has, so the vtable pointer is byte-identical. `BfBuildSpec` at `g_modBase+0x44ABED0` is class-agnostic (it builds an FGameplayAbilitySpec 0xF8 stride from `abilCls, level, inputID, sourceObject`); `BfGiveAbilityNative` reads the LIVE object vtable (`*(uintptr_t*)asc`), so revectoring is followed automatically. The ONE gate the caller must confirm before calling: `botAsc+0x800 == 0` (bCachedIsNetSimulated). Track D already zeroes this at line 19203 (`*(uint8_t*)(botAsc+0x800)=0;`), so the gate is OPEN by the time BOT_K_GRANT would run. Grant returns the outHandle immediately (committed if AbilityScopeLockCount==0) or defers into AbilityPendingAdds; either way handle is valid.
key_findings.evidence: tutorial_launch.cpp lines 21665-21697 (BfBuildSpec + BfGiveAbilityNative; vtable disp 0x778 comment says `[M] offline (dumps/merged14) AND live-verified this session against the real ULokiASC vtable (RVA 0x886E788)`); line 19203 (Track D forces `botAsc+0x800=0` explicitly); line 26275 (`auth gate bCachedIsNetSimulated@+0x800 (0 => IsOwnerActorAuthoritative==true => grant proceeds)`).

key_findings.finding: Track D performs FIVE Loki-specific bot-ASC init steps that must all be preserved (in order) before any grant can succeed: (1) `AddCompByClass(bot, LokiAbilitySystemComponent, "TRACKD-ASC")` — constructor allocates AbilityActorInfo. (2) Cache `bot+0xF00 = botAsc` so `BfGetAsc(bot)` finds it. (3) `K2_InitStats(LokiAttributeSet)` and `K2_InitStats(LokiAttributeSetHealth)` — REGISTERS real attribute subobjects into ASC's SpawnedAttributes (this is the step that avoids the S190 F3/F4 fault where the borrowed CDO ASC's AbilityActorInfo TSharedPtr was null). (4) `InitAbilityActorInfo(botAsc, owner=BfCarrier(bps) or bps, avatar=bot)` at `base+0x447F410` — binds AvatarActor=bot, non-faulting now that (1)+(3) ran. (5) Force `botAsc+0x800=0` (netsim byte) — opens the S144 owner-authority grant gate. STATION 3.5 (line 19262-19280) additionally registers borrowed sets into SpawnedAttributes via DxAppend IF still not registered; this may not be needed for a real-ASC path (K2_InitStats already registers subobjects) but is defensive.
key_findings.evidence: tutorial_launch.cpp lines 19169-19171 (comment: `AddComponentByClass(LokiAbilitySystemComponent) [ctor allocates AbilityActorInfo] -> K2_InitStats(sets) [creates + registers real attribute subobjects in SpawnedAttributes] -> cache bot+0xF00 -> InitAbilityActorInfo [now non-faulting] -> force owner-authority.`); lines 19173-19208 (five-step implementation); line 19203 (`*(uint8_t*)(botAsc+0x800)=0;`).

tutorial_launch.cpp lines 26260-26293 (canonical player K_GRANT path — sketch above is a direct mirror). Function reuse: `BfBuildSpec`, `BfGiveAbilityNative`, `BfCountActivatable`, `LooksLikePtr`, `SafeReadable`, `ClassOf`, `NameId`, `GetFNameStr`, `Markerf`, `Marker` are all already defined and used by the player K_GRANT. Zero new engine-level primitives required — only two pointer substitutions (`asc→botAsc`, `hero→bot`).

key_findings.finding: One risk to record for the flight design: STATION 3.5's `DxAppend` writes into the SpawnedAttributes TArray of the borrowed CDO ASC (a shared class-default subobject). For a real `AddComponentByClass`-built ASC (which Track D's STATION 2 constructs), this is a per-instance write and safe. But the Track D code comments warn that station 3.5 modifies the shared CDO ASC process-wide (line 19260-19261 — 'Modifies the shared CDO ASC process-wide (same scope as ARM G's CDO attribute writes)'). Re-read: STATION 3.5 fires only `if(!setInSpawned)`, and for a real-ASC path K2_InitStats registers the subobjects, so `setInSpawned` should be `yes` and station 3.5 is skipped. VSAI-A1 must NOT re-enter STATION 3.5 for a bot that already passed Track D — the append could double-register. Recommended: gate BOT_K_GRANT on the Track D marker `TRACKD_BUILD ... statsOk=2/2 initAAI=ok` before proceeding, and REFUSE if not.
key_findings.evidence: tutorial_launch.cpp lines 19256-19280 (STATION 3.5 code + comment about CDO scope); line 19262 gate `if(!setInSpawned)`.

open_risks: Not verified this session that BfGiveAbilityNative's `outHandle` and `Items.Num@+0x540` behave the same for a real AddComponentByClass ASC as for the player's KWIREGAS ASC — the S144 measurement (`handle=1, Items 0→1`) was on the player. Predict same behavior because the vtable is identical, but pre-register this as a discriminator: if BOT_K_GRANT reads `handle=0 flt=false` and `Items 0→0`, the AbilityScopeLockCount gate may be closed on a fresh-built ASC and the grant is queued into AbilityPendingAdds instead of committed in-hook; either way `handle>0` is the success signal.

STATION 3.5's DxAppend on a shared borrowed CDO ASC is scoped process-wide; for Track D this is currently fine because Track D itself is the writer, but VSAI-A1 must not re-enter STATION 3.5 for a bot already through Track D (double-register hazard).

Track D was designed to KILL the bot immediately (STATION 6 fires AdjustHealth with a large negative delta). VSAI-A1 must skip STATION 4-6 or move BOT_K_GRANT + puppet-cast BEFORE them, otherwise the bot dies before it can cast. key_findings.finding: Q2: BOT_K_GRANT resolution follows the same class-level pattern as E4T verbatim. E4T's resolve walks: Items.Data + i*0xF8 (per-spec stride) → spec+0x24 = InputID (match filter) → spec+0xC = Handle → spec+0x90 = Rep.Data (TArray<UGameplayAbility*>) → spec+0x98 = Rep.Num → *Rep.Data[0] = ability instance. key_findings.finding: Q3: The compound poke offsets ([+0xF58]=2, [+0xF48]=&WarmupSubobj) are on the ability INSTANCE class (ULokiGameplaySpell), NOT on the owner. They apply verbatim to any ULokiGameplaySpell-derived instance regardless of owner ASC. Named offsets from UHT FPropertyParams (workflow wf_82319383-e54 via tools/re/fk13uht.py against merged14): +0xF58 CurrentStateSpecPhaseType EnumProperty<ByteProperty> (values 0..6 ELokiSpellPhaseType); +0xF59 LastStateSpecPhaseType (sibling byte); +0xF48 CurrentPhase ObjectProperty (LokiSpellPhase*); +0xF18/+0xF20/+0xF28/+0xF30/+0xF38 the 5 phase sub-object UPROPERTY pointers (TargetingPhase/WarmupPhase/ChannelingPhase/InvokePhase/WinddownPhase); +0xF50 CurrentPhaseEffectHandle. UE's UClass::Link reads offsets from the UHT registrar and DEFINES the instance layout — no per-owner variation is possible. Subclass note: BP-generated classes like GS_Ronin_MiniDash_Charges_C add BP variables STACKED ABOVE the native tail, they do NOT change native offsets; the compound poke works identically on any BP subclass of ULokiGameplaySpell.

KBFTRACKD_DELTABITS=0x00000000u (0.0f) required to make Track D's AdjustHealth a no-op. If a successor forgets this override, Track D kills the bot before VSAI can cast. Add a runtime check that reads TrackD's post-kill Health value and REFUSES if killed=yes.

If it fails silently, hitsApplied=0 will show and diagnosis requires reading the target's GAS pipeline for AdjustHealth calls (Loki.log 'Property Health new value' line, same free receipt as S191 E4 flight 3).

BsVsaiPuppetCast runs inside OnPI hook (game thread). All Sleep() calls (up to REPS × INTERVAL_MS + INVOKE_DELAY_MS = 8×250+300 = 2300ms default) block the game thread. This is longer than BsTrackDKill's ~50ms but shorter than PdCdoFlags' ~2000-2300ms GUObjectArray sweeps that already ship. Should not trigger FK-32 baseline but budget accordingly.

KBFVSAI is mutex with KBFE4T (both drive same ability-instance layer). If a successor tries to run them together, #error catches it at build time. But they share the OnPI hook tick and can't be time-sliced within one arm — they must be separate build variants.
